name: leaders
description: Rows of a name and a value joined by a dotted line, for menus, price lists, hours and contents pages.

children.description: A row. Its first child is the name and its second the value; anything after them sits below at the full width.

tokens.name: --yeti-leaders-line
tokens.description: The line between the name and the value, written as a border.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: The space either side of the line.

a11y.notes: The line is decoration and is not read out. Use a dl when the rows are terms and values, and a list when they are links.
